tagging_basis: AQA 7037 specification codes; AS units mapped to the matching A-level leaf

units.summary: Outline what is meant by environmental interdependence.
units.difficulty_basis: 4-mark AO1 outline of a single named concept; familiar content.

units.summary: Analyse a compound bar graph of LEGO sales by region and a map of its corporate locations.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO3 analysis of a graph and a map for one TNC, linking distribution to sales.

units.summary: Using campaign posters and a website extract, assess how important NGOs are in raising awareness of protecting Antarctica.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO1/AO2 short assess applying knowledge to novel NGO source material.

units.summary: Critically assess whether unequal technology flows are the main cause of inequalities in consumption worldwide.
units.difficulty_basis: 20-mark essay requiring links across interdependence and globalisation and weighing technology against other causes.

units.summary: Outline how endogenous factors contribute to the character of a place.
units.difficulty_basis: 4-mark AO1 outline of a named concept; familiar content.

units.summary: Using two photographs and own knowledge, assess how lived experience affects sense of place.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO1/AO2 short assess applying insider and outsider perspective knowledge to novel images.

units.summary: With the distant place studied, assess whether shifting flows of investment have significantly changed its character.
units.difficulty_basis: 20-mark essay requiring a distant place study and evaluation of one process.

units.summary: Outline causes of decentralisation in urban areas.
units.difficulty_basis: 4-mark AO1 outline needing more than one cause; familiar content.

units.summary: Assess the relative importance of factors contributing to a sustainable city.
units.difficulty_basis: 9-mark assess item (AO1 4 AO2 5) requiring prioritisation across sustainability dimensions.

units.summary: Assess whether changes to the carbon cycle will make managing urban environmental problems harder.
units.difficulty_basis: 20-mark essay with required synoptic link to carbon cycle impacts and evaluation across urban problems.

units.summary: Outline the concept of the epidemiological transition.
units.difficulty_basis: 4-mark AO1 outline of a named model; familiar content.

units.summary: Analyse two line graphs of dietary energy supply and food supply adequacy by world region.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO3 analysis of paired time-series graphs.

units.summary: Assess the relative importance of factors with a negative impact on health in a studied local area.
units.difficulty_basis: 9-mark assess item needing local area knowledge and weighing of several factors.

units.summary: Assess whether carbon cycle changes will become an increasingly important cause of migration.
units.difficulty_basis: 20-mark essay with required synoptic link to carbon cycle change and evaluation of future migration causes.

units.summary: Outline differences between primary and secondary energy sources.
units.difficulty_basis: 4-mark AO1 outline of defined terms; comparison required.

units.summary: Analyse iron ore import and export values for the 15 largest importers and exporters.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO3 analysis of two line graphs showing trade flows.

units.summary: Using wastewater and greywater campaign figures, assess challenges in achieving a sustainable water supply.
units.difficulty_basis: 9-mark assess item (AO1 4 AO2 5) applying sustainability knowledge to novel data and campaign material.

units.summary: Assess the extent to which geopolitics will become more important for mineral resource security in future.
units.difficulty_basis: 9-mark extent item requiring forward-looking evaluation of political and other factors.

units.summary: Assess whether carbon cycle changes will create significant challenges for managing energy supply or consumption.
units.difficulty_basis: 20-mark essay with required synoptic link to carbon cycle impacts and evaluation of energy strategies.
